data.name: Furookh
data.gender_notes: Furookh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'farrakah', meaning 'pure, clean, and free from sin'. This name is a reminder to always strive for spiritual purity and righteousness in one's actions. The name Furookh carries the meaning “Pure, clean” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Furookh usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of spiritual purity and righteousness
data.etymology: Furookh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, clean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Furookh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: فروق
in_arabic.meaning: الفرق، الفرق بين الخير والشر، الصالح والفاسد

in_urdu.name: فروق
